preconditions.description: The length of the string t must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string t must be either '0' or '1'.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l1 <= n and 1 <= l2 <= n and 1 <= length <= n - max(l1, l2) + 1 for l1, l2, length in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices and length within the bounds of the string t.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if t[l1-1:l1+length-1] == t[l2-1:l2+length-1] or (t[l1-1:l1+length-1] == '011' and t[l2-1:l2+length-1] == '110') or (t[l1-1:l1+length-1] == '110' and t[l2-1:l2+length-1] == '011') else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each query, the output must be 'YES' if the substring t[l1 ... l1 + len - 1] is reachable from t[l2 ... l2 + len - 1], otherwise 'NO'.
